what: Hold-merge alarm (JC-CA-04) never reaches Telegram. ROOT CAUSE (MEASURED 2026-10-30 05:57Z): .github/workflows/pr-landing-hold-merge-alarm.yml opens its send-ping issue with GH_TOKEN=${{ github.token }} (line 63, 'gh issue create --label system-action' line 133); GitHub does not trigger workflows from events created by GITHUB_TOKEN, so system-actions never runs on them. Evidence: 463 open system-action issues titled 'send-ping: PR #N hold-merge alarm (JC-CA-04)' authored by github-actions[bot], 0 comments (e.g. #21414, created 2026-10-29T21:44Z); a send-ping filed under the operator account (#21360) was processed and closed in 67 s. PI-20261009-KR9P9ZKE-0001 noticed the pile-up (171 then) and was killed without this cause. Fix options: send the ping directly from the alarm workflow (the send-ping script with the Telegram secret) instead of via an issue, or use a PAT/App token for the issue; then close the 463 stale issues as moot. Tier 1 (CI/observability).
